title: Daisy Jones & the Six
author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
summary: Told as an oral history, this follows a 1970s Los Angeles rock band that becomes huge when a magnetic young singer joins it. The interviews trace the music, the rivalry and the break-up that ended it.
readIf: you want a fast, vivid story of fame and creative sparks that reads like a documentary.
skipIf: you dislike interview-style narration or stories where drug use is central.

pairings.reason: Same author and another glamorous, emotional look back at a famous woman's hidden life.
Same author, trading the band for a single famous family and one explosive night.
A quieter, more intense look at two people who keep drifting together and apart.
